poc_scope: Objective: Dedicated POC to validate performance/cost vs Hosted for customer-facing support assistant and doc search.
Duration: 4 weeks (2-week ramp + 2-week steady-state), target start: 2026-03-15
Traffic shape: mirror 10% of production search/support requests (approx 80-120 qps peak), sample test corpus attached.
Performance targets: p95 generation latency < 120ms, p99 < 250ms; throughput 100 qps sustained; error rate < 1%
Cost targets: token cost reduction >= 30% vs hosted baseline for same model family
Model variants: primary = FP16 latest open model (redwood-verified), fallback = 4-bit quantized variant for cost mode; eval harness in place to compare quality.
Canary plan: initial canary 10% of mirrored traffic to Dedicated pool, 3-day observation window; if metrics OK, increase to 50% then 100% for mirrored tests.

Fallback & routing: automated fallback to Hosted API for requests failing Dedicated (>40% errors) or when Dedicated capacity breached. Region failover plan: primary us-west-2, secondary us-east-1, tertiary eu-west-1.
Rollback triggers: p99 latency > 300ms OR error rate > 2% OR automated quality regression on eval prompts (BLEU/ROUGE drop > X) => immediate rollback to Hosted for affected route.
Observability: token-level cost dashboards, per-model traces, sample output diffs saved for 1,000 eval prompts; alerts to Lumina SRE + Redwood AE/SE.
Success criteria: meet latency AND quality thresholds for 72h steady-state at 50% mirrored load; executive sign-off after cost model review.
